title: Pure Raidraptor
summary: Raidraptor cards only, with generic staples. Raidraptors are Level 4 DARK Winged Beasts that swarm into Rank 4 Xyz Monsters and then climb with their own Rank-Up-Magic Spells. The 2024 cards lead. Raidraptor - Noir Lanius searches a Raidraptor of a different Level and shifts Levels from the GY. Raidraptor - Bloom Vulture summons itself and another Raidraptor from the hand, or revives two onto an empty board. Raidraptor - Roost searches a Raidraptor Spell/Trap whenever a Raidraptor comes out of the Extra Deck. Rise Rank-Up-Magic Raidraptor's Force stacks two Raidraptor Xyz Monsters into one whose Rank is their total, up to Raidraptor - Rising Rebellion Falcon at Rank 13. Raidraptor - Brave Strix Sets a Raidraptor Spell/Trap from the Deck. Raidraptor - Glorious Bright negates a card.

Raidraptor - Singing Lanius
